Super Eagles defender Calvin Bassey is reportedly open to joining Manchester United, but Fulham have put a £50 million price tag on him as they try to keep him away from the club. According to TEAMtalk, United believe the Nigerian would be a “very good fit” for new head coach Mauricio Pochettino, and had him on their radar before the Argentine’s appointment at Old Trafford. They are said to be prepared to test Fulham’s resolve in the January transfer window, but a fee of more than £40m would be required, with the London club reportedly holding out for close to £50m. The 26-year-old’s athleticism, pace and recovery speed suit Pochettino’s preference for an aggressive high defensive line. Bassey can play at centre-back and left-back, which gives United a second reason to pursue him as they consider Luke Shaw’s contract situation. Bassey’s contract at Fulham runs until the end of the season, although the club hold an option to extend it by 12 months. Fulham are said to have indicated that they will use the option if no new deal is agreed. Arsenal, PSG, six others nominated for Globe Soccer men’s club award Pochettino arrives at Man United ahead of Liverpool clash EPL: Panel identifies six refereeing errors in one weekend Head coach Alvaro Arbeloa wants the former Rangers and Ajax defender to commit his future, but talks over an extension have reportedly not progressed as hoped, which has led his representatives to monitor interest from elsewhere. Inter Milan are also said to be keeping tabs on him. A sale at the reported valuation would be a club-record departure for Fulham, surpassing the £43.5m they received from Al-Hilal for Aleksandar Mitrovic in 2023. United want a new left-sided central defender in January, even before any decision on Lisandro Martinez’s future. Everton’s Jarrad Branthwaite remains on their radar, while Brentford’s Nathan Collins and RB Leipzig’s Castello Lukeba are also being assessed. Bassey joined Fulham from Ajax in 2023 and has made more than 100 appearances for the club. He has played 12 times in all competitions this season and is currently away on international duty with Nigeria.
